# P08 scope/eligibility checkpoint

Implemented 15 conditional scope/eligibility decisions in the separate v6
applicability-disposition.json. All 26 anchors are tracked: seven conditional
scope/eligibility decisions, one eligibility-only classification decision and 18
pending later-group anchors. EU admission remains false; criterion 3 incomplete.

Added corporate_authority_eu_applicability_v1.py, nine focused tests, builder and
checker integration, fixture pins and a result-note update. The builder accepts
an explicit research history directory to avoid undeclared supervisor writes.
The pre-edit hashes and unchanged cases/comparison baseline are preserved in
p08-v6/applicability-baseline.json. Source-disposition and historical sources are
unchanged. Applicability-check-report.json contains the pre-run evidence/default
audit and will record actual checks. This advances MC06/MC17/MC19/MC30; wider
MC15/MC29 and G4/G7/G8 obligations remain.

Focused tests are running. Next: rebuild with the research history directory,
run the complete standalone checker, compare all baseline cases/comparison and
record actual outcomes. Stop with PARTIAL for independent substantive review.
No compound measurement, notes/lifecycle implementation or admission changes are
included. Classification/issuance, measurement/settlement/notes and remaining
amendment/corrigendum decisions remain the next groups.
